extracted.intended_audience: journal editors, manuscript editors, publishers, peer reviewers, and authors/researchers
extracted.subtask_description: Catalogue and signpost editorial standards, checklists, and guidance resources for scientific editors, reviewers, and submitting authors (e.g., reporting guidelines, ethics checklists, submission checklists, retraction forms). The homepage lists available resources but does not include the full text of each guideline.

rubrics_metrics.name: The SAGER Guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: The SAGER Guidelines (Sex and Gender Equity in Research) — referenced as a major guideline with broad adoption by journals and publishers; noted on the homepage with adoption statistics and anniversary coverage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Homepage only lists the guideline and notes its adoption and impact. No specific SAGER checklist items or criteria are present on this page; follow the linked SAGER guideline page for the detailed reporting criteria and implementation advice.

rubrics_metrics.name: EASE Quick-Check Table for Submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: A quick-check table intended for submissions (title listed under Publications).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Homepage only references the quick-check table by name. The page does not include the table's items or scoring; follow the publication link to see the checklist contents and any submission criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: EASE Interactive Checklist for Submitting Authors
rubrics_metrics.description: An interactive checklist for authors submitting manuscripts (listed under Publications).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only the resource title is shown on the homepage; no checklist items are displayed here. Consult the linked interactive checklist to obtain the actual submission requirements and guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: EASE Ethics Checklist for Authors
rubrics_metrics.description: An ethics checklist aimed at authors (listed under Publications).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The homepage references the ethics checklist but provides no substantive items. Visit the checklist resource to review the ethical standards, required disclosures, and recommended practices for authors.

rubrics_metrics.name: The EASE Form for Authors’ Contributions and Competing Interest Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: A standardized form for recording authors' contributions and competing interest disclosures (listed under Publications).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only the form title is present on the homepage. The form content (what contributions to record, how to report competing interests) is not included here — follow the link to access the actual form and instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: EASE Standardised Retraction Form
rubrics_metrics.description: A standardised retraction form provided by EASE (listed under Publications).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Homepage merely lists the form. No retraction criteria, required statements, or procedures are reproduced on this page; consult the linked resource for the full retraction form and guidance on its use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guidelines for intersectional analysis in science and technology (GIST): Implementation and checklist development
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidelines and an implementation/checklist development resource for intersectional analysis in science and technology (listed under Publications).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Referenced by title on the homepage; the detailed checklist and implementation guidance are not included here. Follow the publication link to see the checklist items and recommendations.

rubrics_metrics.name: SDG Checklist
rubrics_metrics.description: A checklist to help editors and publishers track and report progress towards commitments to the UN Sustainable Development Goals (listed under Publications and in featured resources).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Homepage mentions the SDG Checklist but does not display its items or scoring. The full checklist and any instructions must be accessed via the linked resource.

rubrics_metrics.name: Environmental sustainability and scientific publishing: a manifesto
rubrics_metrics.description: A manifesto on environmental sustainability in scientific publishing (listed under Publications).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shown as a publication title on the homepage; the manifesto's principles or recommended actions are not reproduced here. Consult the document for its standards and suggested practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Writing Your Research Paper: Tips From EASE Editors
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical tips for authors on writing research papers (listed under Publications).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Homepage lists the tips resource but includes no specific stylistic or structural recommendations. Open the linked guidance to view the specific advice and criteria for manuscript quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: The EASE Science Editors’ Handbook
rubrics_metrics.description: A handbook for science editors (listed under Publications).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Referenced by title only on the homepage. The handbook likely contains extensive editorial standards and procedures, but none of its contents are shown here; see the handbook itself for detailed criteria and best practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: The EASE Journal: European Science Editing (articles with recommendations)
rubrics_metrics.description: EASE's journal, which publishes articles (e.g., recommendations and reviews) relevant to editing and peer review; the homepage lists recent articles including topics like academic spam and retraction analyses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The homepage shows article titles and abstracts but does not present prescriptive rubrics directly. Each listed article (e.g., 'Identifying academic spam and recommendations for dealing with it') may contain its own recommendations; follow the individual article links for substantive criteria and guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Peer Review (EASE Peer Review Committee / resources)
rubrics_metrics.description: Peer Review is listed under Communities and there is a Peer Review Committee noted among Special Interest Committees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The homepage indicates EASE has a Peer Review Committee and related resources but does not present committee-produced standards or a peer-review rubric on this page. Visit the Peer Review Committee pages or resources for explicit guidance on reviewer/editor expectations, peer-review standards, or quality criteria.
